 LIVE: Galatasaray vs. Fenerbahçe | Süper Lig
 Galatasaray and Fenerbahçe meet in the Intercontinental Derby, one of the fiercest rivalries in world soccer. With just three points separating the Istanbul giants after eight rounds, Monday's showdown could have major implications for the Turkish Süper Lig title race.
 Watch Galatasaray vs. Fenerbahçe LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 Galatasaray vs. Fenerbahçe: How and Where to Watch the Match LIVE 
 Galatasaray will host Fenerbahçe on Monday, October 26, for Matchday 9 of the 2026-27 Turkish Süper Lig . The highly anticipated encounter will take place at RAMS Park in Istanbul, kicking off at 2:30 PM ET / 11:30 AM PT . After eight league matches, Galatasaray leads the standings with 19 points, while Fenerbahçe sits third with 16 points.
 How Galatasaray Comes Into the Match 
 Galatasaray enters the Intercontinental Derby looking to protect its position near the top of the Süper Lig standings.
 The team managed by Okan Buruk has recorded six victories, one draw, and one defeat in its opening eight league matches.
 In its most recent domestic appearance, Galatasaray secured a hard-fought 1-0 away victory against Gençlerbirliği on October 17.
 The decisive moment arrived in the 88th minute, when Deniz Gül scored the winning goal to give the Istanbul club all three points.
 That result followed a 3-1 home victory over Kasımpaşa , helping Galatasaray recover from its 4-0 defeat against Trabzonspor in September.
 The Lions then delivered an impressive performance in the UEFA Champions League , defeating Lille 4-2 away from home on October 21.
 Yunus Akgün , Aleksey Batrakov , Lucas Torreira , and Victor Osimhen scored as Galatasaray claimed its first victory of the Champions League league phase.
 Now, the defending Turkish champions return to RAMS Park hoping to extend their domestic winning streak and strengthen their position against their biggest rival.
 How Fenerbahçe Comes Into the Match 
 Fenerbahçe travels across Istanbul enjoying its best run of results in the Süper Lig this season.
 The team coached by İsmail Kartal has won three consecutive league matches, scoring 14 goals without conceding during that stretch.
 The sequence began with a remarkable 8-0 victory over Eyüpspor , followed by a 3-0 away win against Rizespor .
 In its most recent league appearance, Fenerbahçe recorded another 3-0 victory over Alanyaspor on October 17.
 Romelu Lukaku , Kerem Aktürkoğlu , and Vedat Muriqi scored the goals that secured the three points.
 The Yellow Canaries have scored 22 goals in their first eight league matches, making them the competition's most prolific attacking team at that stage.
 However, their latest European appearance ended in frustration.
 On October 20, Fenerbahçe drew 2-2 against Slavia Prague in the UEFA Champions League , despite taking an early two-goal lead through Oğuz Aydın and Mason Greenwood .
 The visitors will now attempt to carry their impressive domestic form into one of the most demanding fixtures of their season.
 Galatasaray vs. Fenerbahçe: The Intercontinental Derby Returns 
 The rivalry between Galatasaray and Fenerbahçe extends far beyond the league standings.
 Known as the Intercontinental Derby , the fixture brings together two of Turkish soccer's most successful and widely supported clubs, whose roots lie on opposite sides of Istanbul's Bosphorus Strait.
 The most recent league meeting took place on April 26, 2026 , when Galatasaray secured a commanding 3-0 victory at RAMS Park .
 Victor Osimhen , Barış Alper Yılmaz , and Lucas Torreira scored in a result that strengthened Galatasaray's position in the title race.
 This time, Fenerbahçe arrives with renewed attacking momentum and an opportunity to reduce the gap to its rival.
 With both clubs fighting near the top of the standings, another highly anticipated chapter of the Intercontinental Derby awaits.
